data.title: Global Talent Scholarship 2026/27 award
data.summary: The Global Talent Scholarship Foundation awarded Sam Rivera a scholarship for 2026/27 with a monthly stipend of €450 from October 2026 to September 2027. The first progress report is due on 15 December 2026.
data.explanation: You have been awarded a scholarship paying €450 each month from October 2026 to September 2027, by bank transfer around the first working day of the month. You must stay enrolled full-time, upload your enrolment certificate each semester, and submit a progress report countersigned by your supervisor by 15 December 2026. Report changes of address, bank details or study status within two weeks, and report other grants before accepting them. The letter says the scholarship is generally tax-free, so keep it for your records. An invitation to the Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7 November 2026 will follow.
